content.text: The dashboard is built from a library of React components, exported from `alinea/components`. Use them in
custom fields
, `Field.view` sections and custom entry or root views, so your additions look and behave like the rest of the dashboard, in light and dark mode.
Entry points
Custom dashboard code imports from two entry points:
`alinea/components`: generic UI building blocks, such as buttons, inputs, dialogs and tables. They don't know about your content and work anywhere inside the dashboard.

`alinea/cms`: what is tied to the CMS, such as the hooks that read and write field values, the entry being edited and the signed-in user, `FieldChrome` and the prop types of field, type and root views. See
the alinea/cms API
in Custom fields.

content.text: Usage
The components are styled by the dashboard's stylesheet and theme. They are meant for code that runs inside the dashboard, but work on other pages too (see Theme tokens below).
Conventions
The API follows
shadcn/ui
and
Radix
, so the names will feel familiar:
Compound components are named after their parts: `Dialog`, `DialogTrigger`, `DialogContent`, `DialogTitle`.
Controlled and uncontrolled state use the same prop names everywhere: `value`, `defaultValue` and `onValueChange`; `checked` and `onCheckedChange`; `open`, `defaultOpen` and `onOpenChange`.
Form controls take `label`, `description`, `error`, `required`, `disabled`, `readOnly`, `icon` and `shared`, and render their label and messages with `Field`.
Dates and times are ISO strings (`2026-09-23`, `14:30`). Collection keys are strings or numbers, and a selection is a `Set` of keys or `'all'`.

Every component accepts `className` and `style`. Each rendered part has a `data-slot` attribute (`data-slot="dialog-content"`), and variants are exposed as `data-variant` and `data-size`, which gives your CSS stable hooks.
Colors, fonts and radii come from CSS variables such as `--alinea-fg`, `--alinea-bg`, `--alinea-border`, `--alinea-primary` and `--alinea-radius`. Use them in your own styles to follow the theme.

The props of every component are typed, so your editor shows what each one accepts. Types shared between components, such as `Selection`, `Key` and `IconType`, are exported as types from `alinea/components` too.
Icons
Components with an `icon` prop take an icon component (any component that renders an `<svg>`, such as those from
react-icons
or copied from
Icones
) or an element. The icons of the dashboard itself are exported from `alinea/dashboard/icons`.
Theme tokens

The components are styled with CSS custom properties. `alinea/css` declares them, and its resets, only on elements with a `data-alinea-theme` attribute, so loading the stylesheet doesn't restyle the rest of a page. The dashboard sets the attribute on `<html>`, and popovers, dialogs and tooltips set it on themselves since they render outside the page. To use the components on a page of your site, import `alinea/css` and render them inside an element with `data-alinea-theme`. Add `data-theme="light"` or `data-theme="dark"` to that element to fix the color scheme, otherwise it follows the page.
A theme only sets the inputs, as `light-dark()` pairs where a value differs per color scheme. Every other token is derived from them:
Inputs:
`--alinea-font`, `--alinea-mono-font`, `--alinea-font-size-base` and `--alinea-radius`.
`--alinea-backdrop` (behind panels), `--alinea-bg` (panels), `--alinea-fg` (text) and `--alinea-border`.
`--alinea-primary`, `--alinea-danger`, `--alinea-warning` and `--alinea-success`, with `--alinea-primary-fg`, `--alinea-danger-fg` and `--alinea-warning-fg` for text on them.
`--alinea-ring`: the focus ring.
`--alinea-workspace-color`: the `color` option of the current workspace, set by the dashboard. It falls back to `--alinea-primary`.
Derived tokens, to read in your own styles:
Text: `--alinea-fg-strong`, `--alinea-fg-muted`, `--alinea-fg-disabled` and `--alinea-field-label`.
Surfaces: `--alinea-bg-muted`, `--alinea-muted` (hover backgrounds), `--alinea-input`, `--alinea-overlay`, `--alinea-scrim` (behind dialogs) and `--alinea-border-strong`.
Tones: `--alinea-selected` and `--alinea-selected-fg`, and a `-subtle` background with a `-subtle-fg` text color for `primary`, `danger`, `warning` and `success`, eg. `--alinea-danger-subtle`.
Entry statuses: `--alinea-status-published`, `--alinea-status-draft` and `--alinea-status-unpublished`, each with a `-fg` color.

Shape and motion: `--alinea-radius-sm`, `--alinea-radius-lg`, `--alinea-radius-xl`, `--alinea-shadow-raised`, `--alinea-shadow-muted`, `--alinea-shadow-tooltip`, `--alinea-shadow-modal` and `--alinea-transition`.
The color palette the default theme is built from (`--alinea-gray-500`, `--alinea-blue-800`, ...) is not part of this list and can change.
